questions.question: Where does a business publish its UCP profile?
questions.explanation: Businesses publish at /.well-known/ucp; platforms publish at the URL they name in UCP-Agent.

questions.question: Who is the merchant of record in a UCP checkout on Google AI Mode?
questions.explanation: The business keeps financial liability and the order; Google is not the merchant of record.

questions.question: What does a business compute when a request arrives with UCP-Agent?
options: A price quote for the line items in the request
The capability intersection at the highest shared version
A payment mandate bound to the buyer's credential
An OAuth access token for the platform profile
questions.explanation: It keeps capabilities both list, picks the highest common version and prunes orphaned extensions.

questions.question: What must accompany status requires_escalation?
options: An order id and a permalink_url for the buyer
A payment mandate signed by the credential provider
A continue_url and an escalation-severity message
A 3DS action and a device data collection step
questions.explanation: The business must provide continue_url and at least one requires_buyer_input or requires_buyer_review message.

questions.question: What is the name of the AP2 extension in v2026-08-25?
questions.explanation: It was renamed from dev.ucp.shopping.ap2_mandate when payment extensions moved to common.

questions.question: How does Update Checkout behave?
options: It is a full replacement of the resource
It patches only the fields that the platform sent
It appends the new line items to the existing ones
It is not allowed once the checkout has been created
questions.explanation: PUT replaces the whole checkout, so omitted fields are removed.

questions.question: Which algorithm must every UCP verifier support?
questions.explanation: ES256 is the baseline; ES384 and EdDSA are optional.

questions.question: What default lifetime does a checkout get when expires_at is not sent?
questions.explanation: expires_at defaults to 6 hours after creation.

questions.question: How does UCP handle replay protection?
options: Signature timestamps checked by the business
A nonce recorded on a blockchain by the platform
Session cookies issued by the business to the platform
A signed Idempotency-Key stored by the business
questions.explanation: Replay protection lives at the business through signed idempotency keys, stored at least 24 hours.

questions.question: In which direction do payment credentials flow?
options: From the business to the platform
From the PSP back to the platform
questions.explanation: Credentials flow platform to business only and must not be echoed back.
